title: Condo in Heart of Music Row! Walkable to Downtown
description:
Welcome to famous Music Row in downtown Nashville!  This condo is steps from RCA Studio B,  ASCAP, Curb Records, BMI, Big Machine Records and many more!  Walk on over to great restaurants like the famous Hattie B's, many other restaurants and nightlife or take a 7min Uber to Broadway, The Gulch, Germantown and 12 South.  Also walking distance to Vanderbilt and Belmont University

The setup:
Bedroom 1- Queen bed
Bedroom 2- Queen bed
Fully stocked kitchen and laundry available in the condo.

The space
You have the entire condo to yourself but there are other units in the building so please be respectful of neighbors.

Absolutely NO smoking inside the unit.  

Items provided:
* Hair dryer in the bathroom
* Iron and ironing board
* Keurig coffee maker
* Linens and towels for each guest

Parking is available at the condo (free) and on the street 

Distance to...
Broadway Area- 10min/1.9miles 
The Ryman- 9min/1.8miles
Vanderbilt- 2min/.5miles
Belmont University- 6min/1.2miles
12South Neighborhood- 8min/2.1miles
Grand Ole Opry- 18min/12.4 miles (keep traffic hours in mind with this one)

Guest access
You will enjoy 24-hour access to the condo via a keyless lock, so check-in (3pm) and check-out (11am) are a breeze!

Other things to note
Nashville requires a minimum age of 21 to make a reservation
